description: The latest deploy on the site's host (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare) for a branch: state, address and log link. Check it after the user publishes. Each row is one check (a Worker, a Pages project, Vercel, Netlify or CI); a failed one includes its details. Failed deploys from a connected host also have an id for deploy_logs. Rows from a connected host need a plan that includes host connections; GitHub checks (CI, GitHub Actions) show on every plan.
name: deploy_status
title: Deploy status
